text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need a compact GA acceptance note that customers can read in Console: SLA table, what metrics we show per tier, how credits work, and the opt-in flow for per-route telemetry. Owners?
Noah: I'll handle the SLA copy. Draft: Bronze = best-effort; Silver = 95th <= 120ms; Gold = 95th <= 80ms & 99th <= 200ms (Gold = Dedicated/Reserved only). Add short note about multi-region requirement for global SLA.
Zara: Ops: monitoring will page when route 95th > threshold for 6m or error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Synthetic probes every 5m per-region; pre-GA canary 72h. Runbook: https://wiki/redwood/ops/ga-runbook
Priya: Docs: I'll make the Console card and the opt-in modal. Modal copy: "Enable per-route metrics (adds telemetry). Disabling hides per-route views and may limit SLA credit validation." Include screenshots.
Lucas: Engineering: feature flag = "route_metrics" (default off for Private). Fallback option as per-customer policy (fallback_to_variant, default off). We'll tag fallback=true when active. PRs in 48h.
billing-bot: Billing note: credits prorated by impacted token-seconds, capped at 50% monthly. Reserved customers get 10% discount + throughput guarantees; burst = best-effort + overage billing. Claim window = 30 days.
Noah: Two quick decisions needed: 1) Expose per-route 95th + error% for Silver+ by GA? 2) Make Gold 99th visible only for Dedicated?
Maya: Yes and yes. Priya: show Bronze aggregate only.
Zara: Alert snippet for docs:
```
alert: route_slo_page
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > ROUTE_THRESHOLD
for: 6m
```
Maya: Action items: Noah -> finalize SLA wording + credit example (24h). Zara -> runbook + canary schedule (24h). Lucas -> PRs for route_metrics + fallback tagging (48h). Priya -> Console copy + modal + screenshots (48h). Billing -> confirm credit calc rounding (24h). deploy-bot: any maintenance window?
deploy-bot: Planned GA config push: 2026-06-01 02:00 UTC.
Maya: Great. If anyone can't hit ETA call it out here. Otherwise I'll assemble the customer-facing sign-off doc and circulate tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
